borrow_checker.pattern: cannot borrow .* as mutable more than once
borrow_checker.solution: Consider using RefCell or splitting the borrow into separate scopes

lifetime.pattern: lifetime .* does not live long enough
lifetime.solution: Ensure the referenced value lives as long as the reference, or use owned types

trait_not_implemented.pattern: the trait .* is not implemented for
trait_not_implemented.solution: Add #[derive()] or implement the trait manually

unused_code.solution: Remove unused code or add #[allow(dead_code)] if intentional

common_fixes.async_trait: Use #[async_trait] macro for async trait methods
common_fixes.error_handling: Prefer Result<T, E> over panic! and use ? operator
common_fixes.string_types: Use &str for borrowed strings, String for owned strings
common_fixes.iterator: Prefer iterator methods over manual loops

workflow.1_planning: Define types, traits, and module structure
workflow.2_checking: Run cargo check to validate structure
workflow.3_implementing: Implement methods with minimal viable code
